text: My daily routine is all about consistency. I wake up at six-thirty every morning and start with a glass of water and ten minutes of stretching. After a quick shower and a light breakfast, I leave for work by eight o’clock. My job keeps me busy until five, but I always take a short walk during my lunch break. In the evening, I go for a run or do yoga, depending on my energy. Cooking dinner and reading a book help me relax before bed. I try to go to sleep by eleven, so I wake up refreshed the next day.
